messages.author: 0e879f10f43ef7b0
messages.subject: Multiple users
parts:
How do multiple users using the same shiny program influence each other? Does changing the inputs for one user affect others or are they both isolated. Also, I know there are computing caps. Are these caps on memory and CPU for each user (i.e. shiny account) or each instance of the app that is up?

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Multiple users
parts:
Hi Taylor,

Multiple users using the same Shiny program exist in the same R process, but each user gets their own set of inputs/outputs. It's possible to make users affect each other, by creating reactive values in shared scope but this is a more advanced technique.

The 2GB memory cap is per process, and thus, per app. There are currently no CPU caps in place, but we will send you a polite email if we notice one of your apps using a CPU at 100% for hours, and kill the process if we don't hear back from you.
